scheme_name: National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students
authority: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India
benefit: Full tuition fee + living expenses ₹2,200/month + books and stationery ₹3,000/year + computer assistance ₹45,000

criteria.label: Beneficiary Category (Scheduled Tribe)
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must belong to Scheduled Tribe (ST) community.
criteria.source_clause: Ministry of Tribal Affairs Guidelines Clause 4.1
criteria.remediation: Upload valid ST caste certificate issued by competent authority.

criteria.label: Admitted to degree course in approved technical institution
criteria.plain_description: Student must be enrolled in full-time graduate degree program in an approved technical/higher education institution.
criteria.source_clause: Ministry of Tribal Affairs Guidelines Clause 4.2

criteria.label: Annual family income ceiling (<= ₹6,00,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Total family annual income must not exceed ₹6.00 Lakh.
criteria.source_clause: Ministry of Tribal Affairs Guidelines Clause 4.3

criteria.label: Aadhaar verified and bank account ready
criteria.plain_description: Aadhaar must be linked to active bank account for DBT grant.

application.office_name: Ministry of Tribal Affairs / College Tribal Welfare Cell
process_steps: Register via One-Time Registration (OTR) on the National Scholarship Portal
Apply under Ministry of Tribal Affairs: National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students
Upload verified caste and income certificate
Institute verification via College Nodal Officer
Direct DBT grant transfer into Aadhaar-seeded bank account
